name: Viili

notes: Finnish and Taiwanese culture provenance separated; SBT 0495 and other named isolates in profile
fermentation_scope: Traditional/background descriptions: 18-20 C about 20 h; 20 C/16-24 h. Experimental 22.5 or 26 C protocols kept separate.

name: Långfil
main_microbes_or_features: Ropy lactococci including historical Lactococcus lactis subsp. cremoris LAPT 3001; D/DL aroma cultures in technical description
notes: 18 C is an approximate process point; duration not verified; serial-transfer viscosity instability documented
fermentation_scope: Academic textbook approximate 18 C process point; no verified product-specific time range. Equal bounds do not imply narrow tolerance.

name: Filmjölk
main_microbes_or_features: Acidifying lactococci and aroma cultures; unnamed Leuconostoc mesenteroides subsp. cremoris isolate from commercial Filmjolk
notes: Approximate pH 4.6 technical example; CNP1/CNP2 are chemical fractions not strain IDs
fermentation_scope: Academic textbook conventional process: about 20 C/17-24 h. Equal bounds represent an approximate point, not biological tolerance.

name: Caspian Sea Yogurt
starter_ecology: mesophilic lactococcal starter; LAB-AAB in characterized lineage
main_microbes_or_features: Historical Lactococcus lactis subsp. cremoris FC and Acetobacter orientalis FA; KYG22 separately reported; EPS-associated texture
notes: Primary room-temperature cow-milk protocol 24 h has no measured temperature; current numeric household window is manufacturer-specific
fermentation_scope: Fujicco guidance: powder 25-30 C/about 24 h or 20-25 C/24-48 h; transfer 6-48 h across 20-30 C. Not a universal optimum.

name: Matsoni

notes: Georgian/Armenian regional variation; st265 reidentified as Enterococcus faecium in 2023; strain-code inconsistencies retained in profile

name: Dahi

fermentation_scope: Review pairs 22 C/12-14 h and 37 C/5-8 h; envelope is not a continuous validated range. W8 experimental result 37 C/7 h/pH 4.2.
